terms: Free to read and quote with a link to the page the number came from. Game data and art are © Grinding Gear Games; ExileDB is not affiliated with GGG.

datasets.name: uniques
datasets.title: Unique items
datasets.source: Names, base types and art from the game files (UniqueStashLayout, Words, BaseItemTypes); modifiers from the Path of Building Community unique list.

fields.name: Unique name
fields.explicits: Explicit modifiers every item has (value ranges as in the game)
fields.choices: Lines an item has some of (versions that all drop now, Path of Building variants; empty if none): picks = how many of the options one item has, repeats = the same option can come twice, section = implicit or explicit, options = each option's lines, desecrated = revealed by the player, line = the line with the varying part in brackets when the options are not listed
fields.history: Patches Path of Building keeps an older version for ("Pre 0.4.0"); the modifiers are the current version
fields.legacy: true when GGG's trade site lists it only as a legacy item: it no longer drops
fields.source: Where it drops when it is not a random drop

datasets.name: gems
datasets.title: Skill, support and meta gems
datasets.source: Game files: SkillGems, GrantedEffects, GrantedEffectsPerLevel, stat descriptions.

fields.name: Gem name
fields.levels: Per gem level: level, requiredLevel (character level), cost, lines (effect text, by skill part)

datasets.name: bases
datasets.title: Base item types
datasets.source: Game files: BaseItemTypes, ArmourTypes, WeaponTypes, ShieldTypes, AttributeRequirements, Mods (implicits, hidden base damage stats), ItemInherentSkills (granted skills), Expedition2VerisiumCrafts (runeforging); the base names are what GGG's trade site lists, every game row under such a name included.

fields.name: Base type name
fields.source: drop (rolls as loot), runeforged (made from a normal item at the Verisium Anvil, patch 0.5) or unique (exists only as a unique; runeforged bases whose Verisium Anvil recipe needs a unique are unique too)
fields.forgedFrom: Runeforged bases: what the Verisium Anvil makes them from (name, and the unique the recipe needs, or null for any normal item)
fields.level: Drop level, also the character level it needs
fields.weapon: Physical damage min/max (the physical part), damage: the base's fire, cold, lightning or chaos damage (hidden implicit modifiers: pct = share of the base damage, added = flat; unrounded, the game's tooltip rounding is not in the files), critical hit chance %, attack time ms, reload time ms
fields.implicits: Implicit modifiers every item of the base has, "Grants Skill: …" lines (ItemInherentSkills) included
fields.implicitChoices: The item has one of these sets of lines on top (null if none): same-name game rows that differ only in their implicit, or one of several granted skills. Same-name rows with other numbers are separate records.

datasets.name: passives
datasets.title: Keystones, notables and ascendancy notables
datasets.source: Game files: PassiveSkills, passiveskillgraph.psg, stat descriptions.

fields.name: Passive name
fields.ascendancy: Ascendancy, when it belongs to one

datasets.name: runes
datasets.title: Runes, soul cores, idols
datasets.source: Game files: SoulCores, SoulCoreStats, SoulCoreStatCategories, BaseItemTypes.

fields.name: Name
fields.effects: Effect per slot type: slot, lines

datasets.name: spirit
datasets.title: Spirit reservation of skills
datasets.source: Game files: GrantedEffectsPerLevel.Reservation; per minion = the skill type MultipleReservation (ActiveSkills). Supports change it by their reservation multiplier (GrantedEffectsPerLevel column 22), not their cost multiplier.

fields.name: Skill
fields.perMinion: Every minion reserves this much (the Skeletal gems); false = once for the skill, Wolf Pack's whole pack included

datasets.name: minions
datasets.title: Spectres and companions
datasets.source: Game files: MonsterVarieties, MonsterTypes, MonsterResistances, DefaultMonsterStats, monster packs and world areas; eligibility and Spirit cost follow Path of Building.

fields.name: Monster
fields.category: Monster category (Beast can be a companion)
fields.boss: Unique beast: only the Spirit Walker ascendancy can tame it, and it cannot be a spectre
fields.companionSpiritPct: Share of Spirit a companion reserves, before its modifiers
fields.lifeAt20: Life at gem level 20 (minion level 40), before modifiers
fields.damageAt20: Base damage at gem level 20, before skills and modifiers

datasets.name: keystone-points
datasets.title: Passive points from each class start to every keystone (computed)
datasets.source: Computed from the passive tree graph (passiveskillgraph.psg): shortest path from each class start, every node one point, another class's start not walked through.

fields.name: Keystone
fields.points: Passive points from each start: classes on the start, points (the keystone included)

datasets.name: anoints
datasets.title: Instillable notables and the passive points they save per class start (computed)
datasets.source: Instilling recipes (game files: BlightCraftingItems, BlightCraftingRecipes, BlightCraftingResults) and the passive tree graph: points saved = shortest-path points from each class start to the notable.

fields.name: Notable
fields.emotions: Liquid Emotion tiers in order (1 = Diluted Liquid Ire)
fields.saved: Points saved, per start: classes, points

datasets.name: weapon-ceilings
datasets.title: Best possible rare of every weapon base (computed)
datasets.source: Computed from bases and their modifier pools (game files: Mods, ModType): highest tier and roll of up to three local damage prefixes (separate modifier families in the Mods table, so they roll together) and attack speed, 20% quality; tooltip DPS = average hit × attacks per second.

fields.name: Base
fields.total: Perfect rare total DPS (may use flat elemental prefixes)

datasets.name: unique-weapons
datasets.title: Unique weapons: tooltip DPS at the lowest and highest rolls (computed)
datasets.source: Computed from the unique's base type and its local modifier lines (Path of Building unique list), 20% quality. Lines that depend on the character are listed, not counted.

fields.name: Unique
fields.min: Total DPS at the lowest rolls
fields.max: Total DPS at the highest rolls
fields.uncounted: Damage lines not in the numbers

datasets.name: skill-radii
datasets.title: Skill radii in metres at gem level 1 and the highest level
datasets.source: Game files: GrantedEffectsPerLevel and stat descriptions ("… radius is N metres" lines).

fields.part: What the radius belongs to (Explosion, Impact…), with the skill part when the gem's radii come from several: Impact (Fire-Infused)
fields.level1: Radius at gem level 1 in the same skill part, metres (null when that part isn't there at level 1)
fields.top: Radius at the highest gem level, metres

datasets.name: support-multipliers
datasets.title: Support gems: damage and speed multipliers and cost (computed)
datasets.source: Support gem text (game files: GrantedEffectsPerLevel, stat descriptions): product of unconditional "more/less" damage and speed lines; "more Maximum Physical Hit Damage" (Heft) raises only the top of the range, so it counts as its % × max/(min+max) of the median drop weapon base's physical range; cost from GrantedEffectsPerLevel.CostMultiplier.

fields.name: Support gem
fields.all: Multiplier to all of the supported skill's damage
fields.kinds: Multipliers limited to one kind of damage
fields.cost: Cost multiplier (mana and other costs; Spirit reservation has its own multiplier)

datasets.name: gem-levels
datasets.title: Skill gems at levels 1–40: damage and mana cost
datasets.source: Game files: GrantedEffectsPerLevel (mana), GrantedEffectStatSetsPerLevel (BaseMultiplier: attack damage % of base) and stat descriptions ("Deals X to Y" lines).

fields.parts: Per skill part: label, kind (attack: damage % of base; hit: average hit), values at levels 1–40

datasets.name: best-bases
datasets.title: Base type rankings (computed)
datasets.source: Computed from the bases dataset: weapons by base physical DPS = average physical damage × attacks per second (only the physical part: hidden implicits make some bases' damage partly or all elemental or chaos); armour by base defence. Only bases that drop.

fields.rows: Bases best first: name, level, score
